title: Igitambo cyemerwa mu mbabazi
intro: Funga amaso yawe maze wiyumvire ikibaya kinini kandi gituje aho ukwizera kugeragezwa kugeza aho kugarukira. Ugiye guhura n'umuntu wicishije bugufi imbere y'itegeko ritagereranywa wahinduye igihe cy'ikigeragezo ikimenyetso cy'iteka cy'ukuganduka n'imbabazi z'Imana.
clues: Muri Korowani ndibukwa mu bantu bihanganye bashikamye.
Nari mu iyerekwa ryagerageje kugandukira itegeko rya Allah.
Ubwo nabwirwaga iby'iyerekwa, naramubwiye ngo ukore nk'uko byategetswe uzansanga mu barwayi.
Nari narashyizwe mu gitambo, ariko Allah yavuze ko iryo yerekwa ryasohojwe.
Imana yancunguye mu gitambo gikomeye, insigira icyubahiro mu bisekuruza bizaza.
Ndi Ismail, hamwe na Ibrahim wazamuye ishingiro ry'Ingoro Ntagatifu, wavuzwe hamwe na Idris na Dhul-Kifl mu bakiranutsi.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Guhamagara abapfuye ngo basubire mu buzima ku bw'uburenganzira bwa Allah
Igitambo cyategetswe no kuganduka ku bushake
trial.answer: Igitambo cyategetswe no kuganduka ku bushake

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Yakubiswe n'igisasu gikomeye kubera kwanga ingamiya y'ingore
Yahinduwe nk'inkende kubera kurenga ku mategeko
Ashimwa mu bahanuzi bihangana kandi b'intungane
Yarohamye mu nyanja ubwo yakurikiranaga abizera
outcome.answer: Ashimwa mu bahanuzi bihangana kandi b'intungane

arabic: وَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verse: And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous. (21:86)
